headlines.title: Democrats with 2028 ambitions say their party still must prove itself to win the White House: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Natasha Korecki files a dispatch from a recent gathering of jubilant, but forward-looking, Democrats in Denver.

headlines.title: Stratton undecided on Senate leadership battle: ‘I’m hearing everybody out’
headlines.description: As Democrats prepare to take control of the Senate in January, questions remain over who will lead the caucus. Illinois Senator-elect Juliana Stratton (D) joins Meet the Press NOW to weigh in on the leadership debate and what Democrats need to prioritize when they get sworn in next year.

headlines.title: Nationwide outages may ‘accelerate’ but not because of cyberattacks, says cybersecurity expert
headlines.description: NBC News’ Ryan Nobles, Gabe Gutierrez, Dan De Luce and cybersecurity expert Alex Hammerstone join Meet the Press NOW to discuss the recent technology outages impacting airlines, banks, and the National Security Agency.

headlines.title: Protesters rally in downtown Manila to oppose President Trump's visit to the Philippines
headlines.description: Thousands of people across the Philippines are protesting Donald Trump’s arrival for the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit in Manila, the first stop on his Asia tour before traveling to China. Demonstrators cite concerns over U.S. foreign policy and the Pax Silica project, a U.S.-backed initiative aimed at developing an AI hub in the nation’s capital.

headlines.title: How the White House Correspondents’ Association dinner chaos unfolded
headlines.description: Secret Service faced challenges evacuating President, Vice President, Cabinet officials and Congressional leaders after gunman rushes D.C. gala.

headlines.title: Classified NSA network went down, but no indication it was an attack, sources say
headlines.description: A classified computer network used by the National Security Agency went down due to a technical problem Tuesday, but there was no indication that it was an attack, sources say

headlines.title: Jensen Huang says he would be ‘honored’ if asked to return as Nvidia CEO
headlines.description: Jensen Huang said Tuesday that he would be “honored” to return to his job as CEO of Nvidia if the chip giant’s board of directors decided to bring him back.

headlines.title: Trump brushes aside concerns about outages
headlines.description: President Donald Trump brushed off recent mass outages that wreaked havoc on air travel, banks and emails, saying Tuesday, “it’s life.”

headlines.title: Trump took Qatari jet to Asia, but it’s unclear whether it’s been ‘maxed out’
headlines.description: President Donald Trump, who is traveling in Asia this week, arrived in the Philippines on Tuesday on the Air Force One gifted by Qatar as questions linger about upgrades the White House said were needed after a security threat from Iran forced the president to fly home from Turkey on a secret military plane in July, according to two U.S. officials.

headlines.title: Vance says there’s ‘no daylight’ between him and Trump on the Iran war
headlines.description: JD Vance on Monday said he and President Donald Trump are totally aligned on the Iran war after the vice president this month attributed Republicans’ electoral beatdown in the midterm elections to voter frustrations with the conflict.
